Bug_Title: InputSteam.read() implementation should not return a signed byte
Bug_Explanation: The InputStream.read() method should return an int value, not a signed byte. By applying a bitmask of 0xFF, we convert the signed byte to an unsigned byte, thus fixing the bug.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUNIT test case compares the return value of the showBug method with the expected value of 255. This value is an int, but the bug in the original class is that the read() method is returning a signed byte, not an int. So the value is being sign extended, resulting in -1 instead of 255. This discrepancy causes the test to fail.
